known_edge_cases.description: Several filings include prior-period rows for the same accession; the wrapper classifies identifiers while the staging pre-filter remains responsible for excluding comparative periods.
Rows such as Debt Securities Food Products and Debt Securities Chemicals are industry or issuer subtotal candidates unless they contain acquisition-date or instrument evidence.
known_edge_cases.detection_pattern: Debt Securities <industry> without acquisition date or instrument terms

known_edge_cases.description: From the 10-K for 2024-12-31 some members separate the parts with ', ' or ' - ' ('Debt Securities, Consumer Durables & Apparel, Twin Star International, Inc. Acquisition Date - 01/29/25, 14th Amendment Term Loan - 25.00% inc PIK ...', 'Debt Securities - Consumer Durables & Apparel, Twin Star ...'), and one names the issuer before the industry ('Equity Securities The Legacy Companies, LLC (fka Greenfield World Trade, Inc.) Household Durables Class A Units'). The staging patterns accept both separators, an optional industry after the issuer, amendment and First Out tranche words and an en dash before the rate (printed 'Twin Star International, Inc. 01/29/25 14th Amendment Term Loan - 25.00 % inc PIK').

10-Qs 2023-06-30 to 2024-06-30 tag the Mondee common stock on the bare member 'Equity Securities Software Mondee Holdings LLC' (printed 'Software Mondee Holdings LLC (5) (6) (7) Common Stock 0.8 % 570,627 764,071 4,895,980'), and 2023-06-30 the Shelterlogic common stock on 'Equity Securities Hou sehold Durables Shelterlogic Group Holdings, Inc' (printed 'Shelterlogic Group Holdings, Inc (4) (5) (6) Common Stock 1.7 % 1,254,034 - 11,185,983'); the prefix subtotal filter dropped them. Named under source_encodings.context_identifiers with the identifier the filer uses in its other filings.
known_edge_cases.detection_pattern: quarter total short of the printed 'Total Debt & Equity Investments' by an equity line

known_edge_cases.description: The filed investments figure is the printed 'Total Debt & Equity Investments', which leaves out the money market fund and the Treasury bills ('Total Investments' adds them). The prefix-rule subtotal filter kept a cash row only where its member named a maturity date (Treasury bills 2024-12-31 and 2025-03-31); the money market fund and bill rows of 2023-03-31 to 2025-03-31 are listed under cash_identifiers and published as cash (dispatch.cash_identifier_rows). From 2025-06-30 the filer tags the money fund on ck0001715933:CashEquivalentsAtFairValue and the bills only on InvestmentTypeAxis contexts, so they are not extracted (parked). The bills' percent of net assets is tagged as a ratio above 0.50 in 2024-12-31 and 2025-03-31 ('56.2 %' tagged 0.562; pct_tagged_as_ratio). The cash rows are not given an anchor from the page: where the filer files no cash-equivalents figure (or files 0, 2023-03-31 to 2023-09-30) they are not independently reconciled (orchestrator ruling on the t7af review). The balance sheet prints them as 'Short-term investments 295,865 296,800' (us-gaap:ShortTermInvestments), so that concept is added to the filed cash figure (cash_rows_include_concepts). The plug rule that added cash rows without a context at 2025-06-30 is pulled.
known_edge_cases.detection_pattern: published total above the filed investments figure by a Treasury bill
